tune.example: That catchy tune has been stuck in my head all day.

core: 一群人在共同土地和制度下组成的大整体。

country.example: She has always wanted to visit a foreign country.

state.exampleZh: 该条约承认它是一个主权国家。

land.example: He felt a deep love for my native land.

update.exampleZh: 你能给我一个关于项目的快速更新吗？

tidings.example: The messenger brought good tidings of peace.

nighttime.exampleZh: 这座城市在夜间非常安静。

dark.example: The cat can see well in the dark.
dark.exampleZh: 猫在黑暗中能看得很清楚。

evening.example: He greeted his neighbor with a cheerful good evening.

din.exampleZh: 持续的交通噪音让我睡不着。

clamor.example: The public clamor forced the mayor to resign.
clamor.exampleZh: 公众的喧哗迫使市长辞职。

message.example: I'll leave a message on your desk.

jotting.example: He made a few jottings in his notebook.
jotting.exampleZh: 他在笔记本上随手记了几笔。

digit.example: Enter a four-digit code to unlock.

figure.exampleZh: 销售数字超出了我们的预期。

count.example: We need a head count before lunch.
count.exampleZh: 午饭前我们需要做一个人数统计。

watching.exampleZh: 观鸟是一种放松的爱好。

comment.example: She made a witty comment about the weather.
comment.exampleZh: 她对天气发表了一句机智的评论。

proposal.exampleZh: 他们向投资者提交了一份商业提案。
